get_ipo_calendar.description: Get Segmara's IPO calendar: well-known companies on the road to going public worldwide, from reported preparations to confidential and public filings to priced deals, each with a one-line update. Filter by stage or company. No API key required.

items.summary: Priced its IPO of 8,333,334 shares at $14.00 on October 8, 2026, the low end of its $14 to $16 range, after the SEC declared its S-1 effective that day; the company said trading on Nasdaq as TRXB was expected to begin October 9, 2026.

description: Track US IPOs from filing to lock-up with Segmara's free IPO data. See this week's expected pricings and new filings, recent IPOs and how they have traded since, estimated lock-up expiry dates, this month's S-1 filings, and an IPO calendar of companies preparing to go public. No account or API key required.
